content: Wishlist keeps growing but I never checkout. The size chart is useless, totally wasted my money on wrong fits.
Please let us sort wishlist by discount! I add dresses during sale and then forget.
Returned twice because colour was different from photo. Now I just keep products saved but buy from store.
Ajio has better refunds; on Myntra I hesitate to order anything from my list.
Easiest app to browse; wishlist works fine as a favourites list.
